summary: Skip non-locator archive and backlog sprints in _has_unmapped_earlier_copy during incremental index repair

delivery.outcome: Avoid scanning untouched non-locator backlog and legacy archive-* sprints in _has_unmapped_earlier_copy so incremental index repair succeeds within budget on production stores while keeping locator-removal precedence safety intact.
nonGoals: Changing SQLite index schema, discovery API contracts, or history-locations.yaml format.

architecture.decision: Filter unmapped candidates in _has_unmapped_earlier_copy to locator-eligible sprints (history-* or sprints referenced in locations.values()) because store._record_history_locations_unlocked only writes history-* locators and untouched backlog/archive-* sprints cannot have lost a locator entry.

validation.evidence: Regression test proves incremental archive repair succeeds without opening untouched backlog or legacy archive-* sprints.
All existing index repair and discovery tests including locator-removal rebuild tests pass.
